query: Now, I only want something y'all actually have on hand, not just sittin' on some website somewhere. It's a clock I want, one where the clock function is color changing (I'll check that myself, don't you worry). Nothing over 805 cts, y'all, 'cause that's the top of the trail for me (student loans ain't gonna pay themselves, and every penny counts). If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).
